# Note on the translation

`Hummel_2001_thesis_EN_translation.pdf` is an unofficial, unauthorised English translation of a
Czech master's thesis defended at the Czech Technical University in Prague, Faculty of
Electrical Engineering, in 2001 (author: Petr Hummel). It was produced in 2026, decades after
the original. The PDF is included here unchanged. What follows restates the translator's notes
printed at the end of the PDF.

**Source recovery.** The original PDF was generated by a dvips/LaTeX pipeline with Type 3 fonts
and no Unicode mapping: it rendered correctly but could not be copied or text-extracted. The
Czech text was therefore recovered by OCR (Tesseract, Czech model) from page rasterisations.
Prose recovery was of high quality; equations and figures were not.

**Equations.** All equations were transcribed by hand from the rendered pages and should be
checked against the original. Equations (2.18)–(2.19), illegible in the first scan, were
recovered from the author's original 2001 PostScript file and are reproduced exactly.
(2.4)–(2.5) are standard renderings of the original competition and update rules. Equations
(2.14) and (2.16) carry, as printed in the original, a "+" where differentiating (2.13) yields
"−"; the corrected sign reappears from (2.17) onward, and the conclusion — that the extreme is a
maximum — is unaffected, because (2.19) is negative for m₁ ∈ (0, 1).

**Figures.** None of the figures is reproduced in the translation; each is represented by a
captioned placeholder. The plots, screenshots, vector diagrams and Sammon-projection hypercube
layouts remain in the original PDF.

**Terminology.** The original distinguishes *Kohonenova síť* ("Kohonen network" — winner-only
competitive learning, close to on-line k-means) from *Kohonenova mapa* ("Kohonen map" — the
topology-preserving SOM); the translation preserves the distinction. "Hard Competitive Learning"
follows the terminology of Fritzke's DemoGNG.

**Cross-references.** "Page N of the original" refers to the pagination of the Czech original,
which the translation does not preserve.

**Title.** The original title was not present on the recovered title page; the descriptive
title on the cover of the translation is a reconstruction based on the chapter headings.

This translation has no academic standing. The original Czech thesis is the document of record.
